name: coast
title: Coast
description: An independently maintained Raycast integration to search, inspect, and revisit Coast screen history
author: jerichosequitin

tools.name: get-adjacent-moment
tools.title: Get Adjacent Moment
tools.description: Navigate to a previous or next representative capture with app/domain filters.

tools.name: find-related-moments
tools.title: Find Related Moments
tools.description: Find related captures by URL, title, or application with explicit matching reasons.

tools.name: use-saved-search
tools.title: Use Saved Search
tools.description: List or run locally saved search filters. Does not modify saved searches.

tools.name: explore-around-moment
tools.title: Explore Around Moment
tools.description: Explore grouped captures before and after a known frame, preserving context for drill-down.

tools.name: search-captures
tools.title: Search Captures
tools.description: Full-text search across OCR text and frame titles in the user's Coast screen history. Use for 'where did I see X' questions.

tools.name: get-capture
tools.title: Get Capture
tools.description: Get the full OCR text and metadata for a single Coast frame by its frame ID. Use after search-captures to read a specific capture in full.

tools.name: app-breakdown
tools.title: App Breakdown
tools.description: Get time spent per application, or total time for one application, over a date range. Use for 'how much time did I spend on X' questions.

tools.name: recent-activity
tools.title: Recent Activity
tools.description: Get a chronological summary of usage sessions over a date range, with optional app or domain filter. Use for 'what was I doing' questions.

tools.name: get-capture-image
tools.title: Get Capture Image
tools.description: Export the screenshot for a Coast frame to a temporary local PNG, optionally cropped to the focused window.

tools.name: get-ocr-boxes
tools.title: Get OCR Boxes
tools.description: Get positioned OCR text boxes for a Coast frame when text location and reading order matter.

tools.name: get-accessibility-tree
tools.title: Get Accessibility Tree
tools.description: Get the recorded macOS accessibility tree for a Coast frame to inspect UI controls and structured visible content.

tools.name: get-accessibility-coverage
tools.title: Get Accessibility Coverage
tools.description: Audit stored accessibility attributes for a Coast frame to diagnose capture coverage.

tools.name: list-coast-filters
tools.title: List Coast Filters
tools.description: List recorded application bundle IDs and web domains for use with other Coast tools.

tools.name: sample-activity
tools.title: Sample Activity
tools.description: Get one representative Coast frame per activity segment for a compact overview of an hour or day.

tools.name: browse-timeline
tools.title: Browse Timeline
tools.description: Get a chronological, textually deduplicated Coast timeline for a short period of about 30 minutes.

tools.name: create-coast-link
tools.title: Create Coast Link
tools.description: Create a read-only coast:// deep link to a moment in the local Coast timeline.

tools.name: capture-current-screen
tools.title: Capture Current Screen
tools.description: Capture the current display through Coast, with confirmation and optional OCR. Recording exclusions still apply.

commands.name: gallery
commands.title: Browse Screenshots
commands.subtitle: Coast
commands.description: Visually browse recorded Coast moments with application and domain filters

commands.name: saved-searches
commands.title: Saved Searches
commands.subtitle: Coast
commands.description: Save and rerun local queries and filters without copying recordings

commands.name: activity
commands.title: Coast Activity
commands.description: See app and domain usage over time

commands.name: timeline
commands.title: Browse Coast Timeline
commands.description: Browse recent Coast screenshots and activity highlights

commands.name: grab-screen
commands.title: Capture Current Screen
commands.description: Capture the current display through Coast and copy the image

commands.name: today
commands.title: Coast Screen Time
commands.description: Show today's Coast screen time in the menu bar

preferences.name: coastPath
preferences.title: Coast Binary Path
preferences.description: Path to the coast CLI if not on PATH

preferences.name: defaultLimit
preferences.title: Search Page Size
preferences.description: Results loaded per page, from 1 to 200. More matches remain available as you scroll. Defaults to 20.
